Disable stylus gyroscope 1 minute after hiding cursor
Press the S Pen button and wait a moment to reactivate the gyroscope after inactivity. If cursor hiding above is disabled, the gyroscope will turn off after 5 minutes.
Warning: Continuous use of the S Pen\'s gyroscope may quickly drain the stylus battery.
Are you sure you want to reset all settings to their default values?
S Pen will activate the gyroscope only after the button is pressed, which significantly saves the S Pen\'s battery but may interrupt the connection. Disable if scrolling suddenly stops working.

Last visible percentage from Settings → S Pen, captured by accessibility after you visit the screen once. The timestamp represents the last observation, not continuous battery telemetry. An asterisk (*) means the last reading is old and may be inaccurate.
Restart S Pen motion sensor listener
Opt-in recording of motion, button events, gesture times and S Pen battery parser metadata. Max 2400 events in memory. Enable, reproduce the issue, then export a report.
Calibrate direction — move S Pen RIGHT for 3 seconds after tapping
Android may acknowledge segments much later than their requested length. Optionally increases segment duration up to 24 ms when callbacks are slow. Disable to keep a fixed duration.

A custom hold action replaces normal dragging. To preserve immediate dragging, choose "Normal hold and drag" and assign context menu to the double press instead. Long touch is not a native right mouse click.
With a custom double-press action, a single click waits up to 280 ms for the second press. Ordinary dragging is available after a 120 ms hold. Leave both actions at defaults for immediate drag.
Detailed gesture path and Gallery response
Records touch coordinates sent to Android, timings, and Samsung Gallery scroll/content change event types. No photos or text. UI responses are not proof an image changed. Enable for testing only.
